t2.title: Single-use plastics be completely banned
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should single-use plastics be completely banned?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
Single-use plastics have become an environmental crisis. I strongly believe they should be banned wherever viable alternatives exist.

Firstly, plastic waste is devastating ecosystems. Over 8 million tonnes enter oceans annually, killing marine life and entering our food chain through microplastics. Most plastics take centuries to decompose, creating permanent pollution.

Secondly, sustainable alternatives are readily available. Bamboo utensils, paper bags, and biodegradable packaging can replace most single-use plastics. Countries like Rwanda have implemented plastic bans successfully, proving change is possible.

However, critics argue bans increase costs and inconvenience consumers. Nevertheless, the environmental cost of continuing current practices far exceeds any short-term inconvenience. Moreover, as demand for alternatives grows, prices will decrease.

Furthermore, some medical and hygiene products may require exemptions where no safe alternatives exist. A phased approach allows time for innovation.

In conclusion, banning single-use plastics is essential for environmental protection. Future generations will judge us by our action or inaction on this issue.
t2.sampleA1:
Plastic bad.
No good for sea.
I like paper.
Bye.
t2.sampleA2: I think plastic is bad. It is bad for the animals in the sea and the land. We use too much plastic. We can use paper bags and bottles. They are better. But plastic is cheap and easy. I think we should use less plastic because it is not good for the world.
t2.sampleB1:
I think single-use plastics are a big problem. They make a lot of waste and pollute the environment. For example, plastic bags and bottles end up in the ocean and hurt animals.

In my opinion, we should ban them. There are alternatives like paper straws and reusable bags. These are better for the planet. However, some people say it will be difficult to change. Also, some things need plastic. But I think we can find solutions and reduce plastic use. It's important for the future.
t2.sampleB2: Plastic for a Minute, Pollution for a Century Take a look inside any bin and you'll spot the same culprits: coffee cups, straws, bottles and bags used once, then tossed away. So should single-use plastics be banned for good? I firmly believe they should. The biggest problem is the mess they leave behind. These items take hundreds of years to break down, and in the meantime they clog our rivers, litter our streets and choke marine life. Given that most are used for mere minutes, the damage simply isn't worth it. What's more, we no longer have any excuse. Paper straws, cloth bags and biodegradable packaging already do the job perfectly well, and as demand grows, prices are sure to come down. Countries such as Rwanda have already shown that going plastic-free is perfectly achievable. Admittedly, a total ban would be tricky for certain industries, and some medical products may need exemptions. A gradual phase-out, however, would give everyone time to adapt. At the end of the day, no amount of convenience can justify centuries of pollution. If we act now, future generations will thank us for it, and our oceans will finally begin to recover.
t2.uzSample:
Bir martalik plastiklar ekologik inqirozga aylandi. Men ularni imkon qadar muqobil variantlar mavjud bo'lgan joylarda taqiqlash kerakligiga qat'iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, plastik chiqindilar ekotizimlarni vayron qilmoqda. Yiliga 8 million tonnadan ortiq chiqindi okeanlarga tushadi, dengiz hayotini o'ldiradi va mikroplastiklar orqali oziq-ovqat zanjirimizga kiradi. Plastiklarning aksariyati parchalanishi uchun asrlar kerak bo'ladi va doimiy ifloslanishni yaratadi.

Ikkinchidan, barqaror muqobil variantlar mavjud. Bambuk idishlar, qog'oz paketlar va biologik parchalanadigan qadoqlash materiallari bir martalik plastiklarning o'rnini bosishi mumkin. Ruanda kabi davlatlar plastik taqiqlarni muvaffaqiyatli amalga oshirdi, bu o'zgarish mumkinligini isbotlaydi.

Biroq, tanqidchilar taqiqlash xarajatlarni oshiradi va iste'molchilarga noqulaylik tug'diradi, deb ta'kidlaydilar. Shunga qaramay, amaldagi amaliyotlarni davom ettirishning ekologik narxi har qanday qisqa muddatli noqulaylikdan ancha yuqori. Bundan tashqari, muqobil variantlarga talab ortishi bilan narxlar pasayadi.

Bundan tashqari, ba'zi tibbiy va gigiena vositalari xavfsiz muqobil variantlar mavjud bo'lmagan hollarda istisnolarni talab qilishi mumkin. Bosqichma-bosqich yondashuv innovatsiyalar uchun vaqt beradi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bir martalik plastiklarni taqiqlash atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish uchun zarurdir. Kelajak avlodlar bizni bu masalada qilgan yoki qilmagan ishlarimizga qarab baholaydilar.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Plastik yomon.
Dengiz uchun yaxshi emas.
Menga qog'oz yoqadi.
Xayr.
t2.uzSampleA2: Menimcha, plastik yomon narsa. U dengiz va quruqlikdagi hayvonlar uchun zararli. Biz juda ko'p plastikdan foydalanamiz. Biz qog'oz xaltalar va butilkalardan foydalanishimiz mumkin. Ular yaxshiroq. Lekin plastik arzon va oson. Menimcha, biz plastikdan kamroq foydalanishimiz kerak, chunki u dunyo uchun yaxshi emas.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, bir martalik plastiklar katta muammo. Ular juda ko'p chiqindi hosil qiladi va atrof-muhitni ifloslantiradi. Misol uchun, plastik paketlar va butilkalar okeanga tushib, hayvonlarga zarar yetkazadi.

Menimcha, ularni taqiqlash kerak. Qog'oz somonlar va qayta ishlatiladigan sumkalar kabi muqobillar mavjud. Bular sayyora uchun yaxshiroq. Biroq, ba'zi odamlar o'zgarish qiyin bo'lishini aytishadi. Shuningdek, ba'zi narsalar uchun plastik kerak. Lekin menimcha, biz yechim topishimiz va plastikdan foydalanishni kamaytirishimiz mumkin. Bu kelajak uchun muhim.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Bir martalik plastiklardan keng foydalanish jiddiy ekologik muammoni keltirib chiqaradi va ularni butunlay taqiqlash jiddiy ko'rib chiqishga arziydi. Ushbu plastiklarning ekotizimlarimizga salbiy ta'siri inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Dengiz hayoti yutish va chigallashishdan juda aziyat chekadi, poligonlardagi plastik chiqindilarning to'planishi esa tuproq va suvning ifloslanishiga olib keladi.

Butunlay taqiqlash keskin choradek tuyulishi mumkin bo'lsa-da, amaliy muqobillarning mavjudligi buni amalga oshirish mumkin bo'lgan maqsadga aylantiradi. Biologik parchalanadigan materiallar va qayta foydalanish mumkin bo'lgan variantlar ko'plab bir martalik plastik buyumlar uchun amaliy o'rnini bosuvchi vositalarni taklif etadi. Bunday taqiqning joriy etilishi innovatsiyalarni va barqaror muqobillarga investitsiyalarni rag'batlantirishi, plastiklarga bo'lgan qaramligimizni yanada kamaytirishi mumkin.

Albatta, biznes va iste'molchilarga moslashish uchun o'tish davri zarur bo'ladi. Muqobillari hali mavjud bo'lmagan muhim buyumlar uchun ham ma'lum istisnolar talab qilinishi mumkin. Biroq, plastik ifloslanishni kamaytirishning uzoq muddatli foydalari har qanday qisqa muddatli noqulayliklardan ancha ustundir. Bir martalik plastiklarni butunlay taqiqlash - barqaror kelajak sari zaruriy qadamdir.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the grocery delivery service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear FreshCart Team, Thank you for asking about my experience with your grocery delivery service. I am very satisfied with the service. The product selection is excellent, and items consistently arrive fresh. Your website is extremely easy to navigate, and the delivery drivers are always friendly and punctual. However, I have some suggestions. The substitution policy occasionally results in unsuitable replacements. I would prefer the option to approve substitutions before dispatch. Additionally, the delivery slots for same-day service are often unavailable. I would appreciate more organic produce options and a recipe suggestion feature based on items in my cart. A loyalty program with discounts for regular orders would also encourage more frequent shopping. Overall, FreshCart has made grocery shopping much more convenient. Yours sincerely, Shohruh Salimov
t12.sampleA2:
Hello FreshCart,
I like your shop. The food is good. The man is nice.
But the website is hard. And I want more juice. Because I like juice.
Thank you!
t12.sampleB1:
Dear FreshCart Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you that I like your service. It is very useful because I don't have much time to go to the shop. The website is easy to use, and the delivery was on time, which is important.

However, I think you could improve some things. For example, sometimes the fruit is not very fresh. Also, it would be good if you had more vegetarian options. I think a lot of people would like that.

Thank you again for the good service.

Sincerely,
Shohruh Salimov
t12.sampleB2: Dear FreshCart Team, Thank you for inviting me to share my thoughts after my first few orders with your grocery delivery service. On the whole, I have been very pleased. The product selection is impressive, deliveries turn up on time, and the fruit and vegetables are always fresh. I also find your website refreshingly easy to use, which makes ordering a breeze. That said, there are one or two points I would like to raise. Firstly, the same-day delivery slots tend to fill up far too quickly, so it would help to offer more of them. Secondly, your substitution policy occasionally leaves me with items I never wanted; being able to approve replacements in advance would put this right. I would also welcome a wider range of organic produce and a loyalty scheme for regular customers. Overall, keep up the great work. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev

Hurmat bilan,

Shohruh Salimov
